Shraddha Kapoor's film 'Eetha' release date postponed

The release of the film 'Eetha', starring Shraddha Kapoor and based on the life of Lavani dancer Vithabai Narayangaonkar, has been postponed from its original August release date. The film, which also features Randeep Hooda and Anant Joshi, will now be released in December. This new release date avoids a clash with Yash's film 'Toxic' and positions it against Prabhas' film 'Fauzi'.
